action.objective: Convert the b4 passed pawn while containing Black's d4 passer with the king on a4.
action.rationale: Ka4 is the sole commit_ready move: exact depth-4 score -28, corroborating single-candidate verification with no mate or tactical refutation. Broad search showed all four king moves scored -28, so Ka4 is at least as good as alternatives. Plan: push b4-b5 supported by the king, then run the passer while the king guards against d4-d3-d2.
